# Construct BIBD(13,3,2) by doubling STS(13)
v = 13
base_blocks = [[0,1,4], [0,2,7]]

# Generate all blocks of STS(13)
blocks_sts = []
for i in range(v):
    for base in base_blocks:
        block = [(x + i) % v for x in base]
        blocks_sts.append(sorted(block))

print("Number of STS blocks:", len(blocks_sts))
print("STS blocks:", blocks_sts)

# Now double them
blocks = blocks_sts * 2  # 52 blocks

# Verify parameters
from collections import Counter

# Check block sizes
for b in blocks:
    assert len(b) == 3

# Check point frequencies
freq = Counter()
for b in blocks:
    for p in b:
        freq[p] += 1
print("Point frequencies:", sorted(freq.items()))
assert all(f == 12 for f in freq.values())

# Check pair frequencies
pair_freq = Counter()
for b in blocks:
    for i in range(3):
        for j in range(i+1,3):
            pair = tuple(sorted([b[i], b[j]]))
            pair_freq[pair] += 1
print("Pair frequencies:", sorted(pair_freq.items()))
assert all(f == 2 for f in pair_freq.values())

# Build incidence matrix flat list
b_total = 52
flat = []
for i in range(v):
    for j in range(b_total):
        flat.append(1 if i in blocks[j] else 0)

print("Length:", len(flat))
print("First few:", flat[:20])
